summary: Library of 110+ animated React components built with Motion and Tailwind CSS: copy the source or install via the shadcn CLI.
description: A collection of animated React UI components — text animations, tabs, loaders, inputs, cards, carousels, modals, navbars and more — built with React, Motion, Tailwind CSS and TypeScript. Browse by category, preview each motion on hover, then copy-paste the source or add it with the shadcn CLI; every component page lists dependencies, the Motion APIs used, props and accessibility notes. Free developer tools (Framer Motion component and spring generators, Tailwind grid generator) and 26 free components sit alongside the lifetime plan.
